attributes.name: section heading size
attributes.definition: Relative font size of section-level (h2) headings compared with the hero heading or other page text.

values.definition: Section headings are small, around label or body-adjacent size, much smaller than the hero heading.
Section headings are moderately sized, clearly larger than body text but smaller than the hero heading.
Section headings are large and close to or matching the hero heading in scale.
Size is not stated or does not fit the other values.

attributes.name: section heading text treatment
attributes.definition: Casing, weight and tracking treatment applied to section headings.

values.definition: Uppercase, bold and letter-spaced so the heading reads as a label.
Bold heading in normal casing without added letter-spacing.
Normal-weight heading with no special treatment.
Treatment is not stated or does not fit the other values.

attributes.name: heading underline accent bar
attributes.definition: Whether headings carry a decorative underline bar or rule beneath them.

values.definition: Headings have a decorative underline bar or rule.

attributes.name: footer heading size relative to body headings
attributes.definition: How footer headings compare in scale with body-section headings.

values.definition: Footer headings are clearly smaller than body-section headings.
Footer headings are larger than body-section headings.
Not stated or no footer headings.
Headings align to the left edge.

codes.attribute: footer heading size relative to body headings
